title: SoundMix
description: Mixing and spatial sound (B8 R7, B2512): buses with default volumes, how loud a sound is at a distance from the listener (camera), how far it can be heard, how zoom changes the hearing range, and how many sounds a bus plays at once. All distances are metres; core positions are converted to metres via cell_size_cm of the world preset (B2), so changing the cell size does not change these values.

MixZoom.description: Zoom changes the hearing range (B2512); interpolated linearly between near and far.

near_factor.description: Hearing range factor when fully zoomed in (camera close).

far_factor.description: Hearing range factor when fully zoomed out.

volume_db.description: Default volume of the bus; the player changes it in the settings (B6).

max_voices.description: Sounds this bus plays at once; the nearest win (60 FPS budget with 100 inhabitants).

full_volume_m.description: Up to this distance the sound plays at full volume.

silent_m.description: From this distance on the sound is silent (maximum distance). 0 = not spatial (music, master).

curve.description: How the volume falls between full_volume_m and silent_m: linear in gain, or smooth (squared), gentle for ambience.

MixPlayerRange.description: Range of the volume sliders per bus in the player settings (B6 R4).
